signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

signed_per_output_power_evidence.definition: Peak phasors: Videal=Vmetal+50I; P=.5Re(V*conj(I)); resistor=50|I|^2/2; RMS=sqrt(sum_f|I|^2/2)
signed_per_output_power_evidence.signed_power_scope: Metal delivered power includes passive-output absorption; no negative value clamped
signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

footprint.interpretation: Contact footprint differs between C1 and TIS cohorts; RMS matching does not equalize footprint

circuit.note: C1 basis also separately evaluated at 3030 Hz; square_3h has explicit harmonics

limitations: 40 finite probe directions do not locate the whole-volume maximum or prove physiological selectivity.
Spatial reconstruction is cell-centred and interface-aware; sampled phi-E agreement does not prove mesh convergence.
No tip contact, probe R/C loading, calibration, actual attenuation switch, noise or detectability is validated.
Fixed-axis fundamental tip-voltage envelope is not the original direction-max electric-field TIS objective.
Waveform RMS matching is not equal neural recruitment, direct muscle excitation, force or safety.
probe.native_gate_reuse: Same original native phi/E arrays; only exact actual waveform coefficient ratios differ

source_voltage_evidence.source_Vpp_definition: Whole open/highZ waveform before50ohm; loaded-metal/contact voltages remain separate
source_voltage_evidence.method: Actual ideal source phasor = saved loaded metal phasor +50ohm*saved source current; RMS=sqrt(sum(abs(ideal)^2)/2)
